meta.name: add-gmail-tool
meta.description: Add Gmail as an MCP tool (read, search, send, label, draft) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. The agent gets Gmail tools in every enabled group; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time so no raw credentials are ever in the container or on disk in usable form.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 MCP 工具读取、搜索、发送和管理 Gmail 邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 agent 中通过 MCP 操作 Gmail 邮箱。
copy.tagline_en: Read, search, send, and manage Gmail emails via MCP tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Gmail from an agent via MCP.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能在对话中直接使用Gmail功能，如搜索、阅读、发送邮件，管理标签和过滤器等。所有操作通过安全的OAuth授权执行，无需手动输入密码。
howto.when: 当用户向启用了该技能的代理群组提出Gmail相关请求时触发，例如要求搜索收件箱、发送邮件或管理标签。

say.note: Claude会调用标签列表工具，返回所有标签。

say.text: 搜索我收件箱里上个月的发票邮件。
say.note: Claude会搜索Gmail并返回相关结果。

say.text: 给我发送一封测试邮件到example@gmail.com。

howto.what_en: Claude gains Gmail tools (search, read, send, draft, delete, manage labels/filters) secured by OneCLI OAuth injection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks the agent to perform Gmail actions, such as searching inbox, sending email, or listing labels.

say_en.text: Search my inbox for last month's invoices.
say_en.note: Claude searches Gmail and returns results.

say_en.text: Send a test email to example@gmail.com.
say_en.note: Claude drafts and sends the email.
